title: Locale registry
description: The languages the experience can be read in, their authoring budgets, and the presentation facts a scene needs in order to lay their text out.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

sourceLocale.description: The language of the original public-domain text in text/raw/.

baseLocale.description: The retelling every translation works from.

maxChars.description: Authoring budget per segment. A limit on how long a sentence may be written, not a promise that it fits one rendered line.

dir.description: Base writing direction for this language's text.

lineBreak.description: CSS line-break keyword a scene should apply to this language's text.

significantSpaces.description: True when spaces inside a segment are authored content, as in the Japanese phrase spacing. Such text must never be trimmed, collapsed, or re-wrapped by a template or a minifier.
